# EMCL Desktop app icon

Generated with the built-in ImageGen tool. The icon uses a transparent canvas,
a navy tile, a cyan electricity-meter dial, and a white lightning bolt.

Production assets are in `EMCLDesktop/Assets`:

- `emcl-desktop.png`: 1024 × 1024, transparent PNG.
- `emcl-desktop.ico`: Windows and window icon, 16–256 px.
- `emcl-desktop.icns`: macOS app bundle icon, up to 1024 px.

ICO and ICNS variants were produced by resizing and converting the generated
image, preserving transparency.

## Generation prompt

Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: final desktop application icon for EMCL Desktop, a DLMS/COSEM electricity-meter reader and packet inspector on macOS, Windows and Linux. Create ONE polished square 1024x1024 app icon, not a presentation sheet or mockup. A dark midnight navy rounded-square tile with generous macOS-style rounded corners, centered on a genuinely transparent canvas; tile occupies about 84% of image width. Bold, compact, highly legible central emblem: a luminous cyan / teal circular meter dial with a small deliberate gap and a crisp warm-white lightning bolt centered inside it, subtly suggesting electricity measurement and digital communication. Two substantial clean terminal marks integrated at the base of the dial, not tiny decorative dots. Refined contemporary macOS app aesthetic, restrained dimensionality, crisp geometry, very subtle inner gradient and bevel, controlled cyan light against deep navy. Large clean shapes, strong silhouette readable at 16px, ample breathing room, no texture noise. Front view, perfectly centered, one unified icon. No lettering, no numbers, no words, no watermark, no Avalonia branding, no device mockup, no outer background, no large external drop shadow. Preserve real alpha transparency outside the rounded tile.
